description: This file defines the Debug class within the Opencart catalog's controller event namespace. It provides methods for measuring and logging the execution time of routes during the application's runtime, specifically through 'before' and 'after' hooks.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: Controller for debugging routes by timing their execution and logging the data.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Stores the current time before executing a route, for timing purposes.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time after a route executes and logs the timing data.
